article.story: No. 13 Texas Tech (1-0) at Oregon State (0-1), Sept. 12 at 7:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Texas Tech by 26.5. Against the spread: Texas Tech 0-1, Oregon State 1-0. How to watch: CBS/Paramount+ Key stats Texas Tech Offense Overall: 471 yards per game (52nd in FBS) Passing: 298 yards per game (39th) Rushing: 173 yards per game (61st) Scoring: 33 points per game (69th) Texas Tech Defense Overall: 194 yards per game (29th in FBS) Passing: 119 yards per game (34th) Rushing: 75 yards per game (41st) Scoring: 10 points per game (38th) Oregon State Offense Overall: 402 yards per game (68th in FBS) Passing: 376 yards per game (11th) Rushing: 26 yards per game (136th) Scoring: 20 points per game (98th) Oregon State Defense Overall: 533 yards per game (130th in FBS) Passing: 305 yards per game (117th) Rushing: 228 yards per game (121st) Scoring: 33 points per game (107th) Oregon State is 122nd in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 53.8% of third downs. Oregon State ranks 14th in the FBS with a +2 turnover margin. Both teams have strong red zone offenses, each scoring on 100% of trips to lead the FBS. Team leaders Texas Tech Passing: Will Hammond, 298 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT, 78.8 completion percentage Rushing: J'Koby Williams, 71 yards on 13 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Kenny Johnson, 76 yards on 4 catches, 0 TDs Oregon State Passing: Braden Atkinson, 376 yards, 1 TD, 0 INTs, 60.4 completion percentage Rushing: Kourdey Glass, 25 yards on 6 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Jesse Legree, 136 yards on 5 catches, 1 TD Last game Texas Tech won 33-10 over Abilene Christian on Sept. 5. Hammond threw for 298 yards on 26-of-33 attempts (78.8%) with one touchdown and one interception. Williams had 71 rushing yards on 13 carries and one touchdown, adding eight receptions for 57 yards. Johnson recorded 76 yards on four catches. Oregon State lost 33-20 to Houston on Sept. 5. Atkinson led Oregon State with 376 yards on 29-of-48 passing (60.4%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for -31 yards and one rushing touchdown. Glass had 25 rushing yards on six carries, adding three receptions for 15 yards. Legree put up 136 yards on five catches with one touchdown. Next game Texas Tech hosts No. 22 Houston on Sept. 18. Oregon State hosts Montana on Sept. 19.
